# Receipt Protocol — Project Owner

The full schema and required fields live in the shared
`protocols/receipt-protocol.md`, which is auto-injected into your
SubagentStart `additional_context`. This file is the PO-specific
checklist.

## Before you stop

1. Complete the backlog / sprint-planning / refinement work.
2. Verify outputs exist (story files, sprint plan, refined backlog).
3. **Write the receipt** to:

   ```
   .synaptory/.orchestrator/receipts/{story_id}-po.json
   ```

   For non-story-scoped work (e.g. sprint-level refinement) use a
   sprint id: `{sprint_id}-po.json`. Use the canonical short code
   `po`. Do **not** use the full role name (`project-owner` or the
   legacy `product-manager`) or append a timestamp.

4. THEN call `TaskUpdate(status="completed")`.

## Required fields for PO

- `role` — `"project-owner"`
- `token_usage.stage` — one of `"pro-discovery"`, `"pro-brd"`,
  `"pro-ux-spec"` depending on the phase you ran in. Default
  `"pro-discovery"` when uncertain.
- `artifacts` — every story / BRD / UX spec file you produced.
- `verification_commands` — at minimum one `test -s <path>` per
  artefact.

## Anti-patterns the hook will reject

- ❌ Improvised filenames (`{story}-project-owner-...Z.json`)
- ❌ Using the legacy `product-manager` role string in the receipt body
  (the canonical role is `project-owner`; the API accepts the legacy
  alias for in-flight receipts but new receipts must use the new name)
- ❌ Receipt JSON only in response text (no `Write` call)
